target.title: feat(ui): merge the voice level meter into the stop-voice pill and disambiguate the stop controls
target.body:
Closes #102756

## What Problem This Solves

While browser Talk (voice input) is active, the Control UI composer showed a small floating pill of dots above the input row, and the voice-stop control was a rounded danger square identical to the "Stop generating" square that appears while a run is abortable. With both active, two indistinguishable red stop squares sat side by side, and the floating pill added vertical jump without reading as a control.

## Why This Change Was Made

The live input-level meter now lives inside the stop-voice control itself: while Talk is live, the mic button becomes an accent pill containing the existing level-driven waveform bars, with a stop glyph that crossfades in on hover/focus and a soft breathing glow (static under reduced motion). The floating row above the composer is gone (voice errors keep their dismissible alert row). "Stop generating" stays the single danger control, now a filled square on a soft danger fill so it reads as the one destructive action. Status announcements (Connecting voice input... / Listening... / Asking OpenClaw...) remain a polite screen-reader live region, and the meter element keeps its class/data-attribute contract for the talk e2e suite. When a running session reports a transport error (transports keep the session active on status "error"), the control drops the meter and shows its stop glyph instead of a fake listening waveform, and the live region yields to the existing error alert row so the failure is announced once.

## User Impact

- One glanceable control per concern: a live waveform pill stops voice; a single red square stops the run. No more twin stop squares.
- The composer no longer grows an extra row while voice is active.
- Keyboard/screen-reader behavior is unchanged: same labels, same live-region announcements, reduced-motion users get static bars and no glow animation.

## Evidence

- Unit: `pnpm test ui/src/pages/chat/chat-composer.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts` — 145 tests pass, including a new guard that the voice control and the run-stop control render with distinct classes and exactly one danger stop square exists while both are active.
- E2E (real Chromium + mock gateway): `pnpm test ui/src/e2e/browser-talk-start-stop.e2e.test.ts` — 4 tests pass, including a new spec that starts voice, starts an abortable run on top, asserts both controls stay independently clickable (stopping voice does not `chat.abort`), and captures the proof screenshots below. `ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-redesign.e2e.test.ts` also passes.
- Screenshots (from the deterministic e2e harness, light + dark):

| State | Screenshot |
| --- | --- |
| Voice live (listening) | ![voice live listening](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/openclaw/voice-live-pill-102756/01-voice-live-listening.png) |
| Voice + abortable run, light | ![voice plus run stop light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/openclaw/voice-live-pill-102756/02-voice-plus-run-stop.png) |
| Voice + abortable run, dark | ![voice plus run stop dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/openclaw/voice-live-pill-102756/03-voice-plus-run-stop-dark.png) |
| Hover reveals stop glyph | ![hover stop glyph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/openclaw/voice-live-pill-102756/04-voice-live-hover-stop-glyph.png) |

Before state (floating dots pill + two identical stop squares) is described with rationale in #102756.
